title: Cyberpartisanen and Silent Crow claim they took Russian war-death records from Rosstat; Spiegel reports nine Germans among the dead
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (23 November); the day of the intrusion is not stated.
geo_basis: country of the agency (Rosstat, Russia's statistics agency) as the source states it
summary: ORF reports that the Belarusian group Cyberpartisanen and the Ukrainian group Silent Crow took death records from the servers of Russia's statistics agency Rosstat and gave them to selected media, including Spiegel. Spiegel says the records list nine Germans among Russian war dead. dpa-AFX reports that Rosstat confirmed a cyberattack in early November but denied that any data leaked.
plain: Two hacker groups say they took Russian war-death records from the statistics agency Rosstat and passed them to media. Rosstat confirmed an attack but denied a data leak, dpa-AFX reports.
exec: Two hacker groups reportedly took war-death records from a Russian state agency, according to ORF and dpa-AFX; Rosstat denied that data leaked, dpa-AFX reports.

validation.note: ORF.at and the dpa-AFX wire (finanzen.net) were read. dpa-AFX relays Rosstat's confirmation of an early-November cyberattack and its denial of a leak; Rosstat's own page was not read.
